meta.title: Flow TV: Free 24/7 AI Channels, Powered by Veo
meta.description: Flow TV is Google Labs' free 24/7 stream of AI-generated channels powered by Veo — hop themed channels or shuffle, see the prompt behind every clip, no account.

h1: Flow TV: free channel surfing, prompts on screen

faqs.a: Yes — it's a free Google Labs experiment, currently available in supported regions. No account is required to start watching.
Google's Veo model family generates the channels' video, with audio. Each clip plays with the prompt that produced it shown on screen.

faqs.q: Can you steer Flow TV like other live AI channels?
faqs.a: Not by voting — Flow TV is built for passive channel surfing: hop between themed channels or shuffle everything together, and read the prompts behind each clip as it plays.
